title: Agent mixtures and volatility clustering
purpose: Confirmatory test: do trend followers raise volatility clustering versus the random-order baseline
primary_outcome: VCI (mean ACF of absolute mid returns lags 1-10)
arms: A0 ZI; A1 ZI+TF; A2 ZI+MR; A3 ZI+TF+MR
planned_analysis: Paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI of mean VCI difference A1-A0; d_z; Holm for secondary contrasts

title: Liquidity supply and spread
purpose: Effect of ZI limit-order supply on spread and its interaction with trend followers
arms: 3 liquidity levels x {ZI; ZI+TF}; low-ZI+TF excluded from contrasts
status: complete (M3 2026-11-25): 180/180 runs; primary supported; low-ZI+TF degenerate 30/30 (excluded, A1)
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap CI of spread difference low-high liquidity (ZI-only); interaction on VCI at medium vs high (secondary); low-ZI+TF reported but excluded from every contrast (A1); Holm

title: Response to an exogenous sell shock
purpose: Drawdown and recovery after one large market sell across mixtures (optional under time budget)
status: complete (M3 2026-11-25; optional, run in full): 90/90 runs; primary supported; spread widening not measured (D-013)
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap CI of drawdown difference ZI+TF minus ZI; censored recovery times descriptive

title: Sensitivity analyses that could invalidate EXP-001
purpose: Placebo-aggressiveness arm; tick size; sampling interval; exclusion of flagged runs
arms: A4 ZI+PA (pa_skip_prob 0; matched to tick-1 A1); A0 and A1 at tick 2; EXP-001 reanalysis at dt 10 and 200
status: complete (M3 2026-11-25): 90/90 runs plus reanalysis; robustness rule: invalidated (dt sign reversal)
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap CIs; robustness rule in protocol section 4

title: Simulated and real-market statistics (FI-2010)
purpose: Descriptive second test: place EXP-001 arms against real-market reference ranges of VCI, realised volatility and relative spread; held-out day check of real VCI > 0
primary_outcome: Placement of each arm's 95% CI against the reference range; held-out VCI > 0 in all five stocks
arms: EXP-001 A0 A1 A2 A3 vs 37 reference blocks (days 1-9) and 5 held-out stock-days (day 10)
status: complete (M3 2026-11-25): 0 new runs; held-out check (a) not supported (4 of 5 stocks); placement descriptive
planned_analysis: Percentile bootstrap 95% CI of arm means (10,000 resamples, seed 20261124) classified inside/overlapping/below/above the reference [min, max]; sensitivity at dt 10 and 200; descriptive, never changes EXP-001
